# Amol Veg Resto

> 100% Pure Vegetarian Restaurant in Sakhar Peth, Solapur, Maharashtra, India. Established in 1990.

Amol Veg Resto is a premier pure vegetarian dining destination in Solapur, Maharashtra. Located on Karnik Nagar Road near Ashok Chowk in Sakhar Peth, the restaurant specializes in authentic South Indian breakfast, traditional Maharashtrian meals, hearty North Indian and Punjabi curries, Chinese wok specials, tandoor flatbreads, and aromatic filter coffee.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://amolvegresto.in/): Homepage featuring our culinary heritage, signature popular dishes, customer reviews, and frequently asked questions.
- [Digital Menu](https://amolvegresto.in/menu/): Complete interactive pure vegetarian menu featuring 24 categories, 280+ dishes with transparent prices, and direct WhatsApp ordering.
- [About Us](https://amolvegresto.in/about): Background on our restaurant, culinary standards, hygiene practices, and pure vegetarian philosophy.
- [Photo Gallery](https://amolvegresto.in/gallery): High-resolution photos of our restaurant interior, dining halls, and freshly prepared dishes.
- [Contact & Location](https://amolvegresto.in/contact): Address, phone numbers, opening hours, and direct Google Maps navigation to our restaurant in Solapur.
